notes: The reference's own pictures are stock; nothing of them is used.
Photographs that carry text are darkened (80 % brightness, near-black veil 40-88 %); a bright room becomes a grey one. That is the reference's look and what keeps every line readable.
A step's 2.9:1 banner is cropped to its middle third in an upright card (clinic1).
The client's accent is used once: the filled button of the closing band (and of a marked plan). The reference has no accent colour.
The band colour is the client's ink taken down until white reads on it (law1: its navy as given; clinic1: #363636 becomes #303030).
law1's group photograph is 1128 wide and is shown 1440 wide (1.28x its pixels) as the band over the team.
A long catalogue with long texts makes a long page (clinic1: 3000 px of services at 1440, 5100 at 390).

holds_without_pictures_note: It renders clean and legible with none (law1 and clinic1 with every picture removed: no sideways scroll, one h1, legible ok), but it is then a type page on a deep-coloured first screen and no longer this reference, whose whole character is dark photographs. Offer it only to a client that meets photos_by_role; with fewer, prefer a type-led template.
